questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.objective: 3.1 Describe the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which are the four dimensions of service management in ITIL 4?

answers.text: Organizations and people; information and technology; partners and suppliers; value streams and processes
Plan, improve, engage, and deliver and support
Incident, problem, change, and service request
Utility, warranty, cost, and risk

explanations.a: The four dimensions are organizations and people, information and technology, partners and suppliers, and value streams and processes. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Definition clue 111: regarding four dimensions of service management, these are service value chain activities, not the four dimensions.
explanations.c: Scenario clue 111: regarding four dimensions of service management, these are practice-related concepts, not the four dimensions.
explanations.d: Answer boundary 111: regarding four dimensions of service management, these are key service management concepts, not the four dimensions.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.objective: 3.1 Describe the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Why should all four dimensions be considered?

answers.text: To replace the guiding principles with a mandatory checklist
To ensure a holistic approach to service management and avoid unmanaged constraints
To make every service use the same supplier and the same process design
To ensure that technology decisions are made without considering people or suppliers

explanations.a: Practice logic 112: regarding four dimensions of service management, the dimensions do not replace the guiding principles; they support holistic thinking.
explanations.b: Considering all four dimensions helps organizations manage services holistically. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Recognition clue 112: regarding four dimensions of service management, the dimensions guide consideration, not identical design for every service.
explanations.d: Foundation check 112: regarding four dimensions of service management, the dimensions encourage consideration beyond technology alone.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.objective: 3.1 Describe the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: A regional bank's IT operations team is reviewing service management practices. A team designs a service by selecting a tool but ignores skills, suppliers, workflows, and data. Which concept has been overlooked?

answers.text: The service desk channel
The definition of a user
The four dimensions of service management
The incident management practice

explanations.a: Concept contrast 113: regarding four dimensions of service management, a service desk channel is narrower than the overall dimensions needed for service design.
explanations.b: Exam wording 113: regarding four dimensions of service management, a user is a role that uses services; the issue is the lack of holistic service design.
explanations.c: The four dimensions help prevent a narrow technology-only view of service management. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Role clue 113: regarding four dimensions of service management, incident management may be involved later, but the design gap concerns all four dimensions.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.objective: 3.1 Describe the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which statement about the four dimensions is CORRECT?

answers.text: They apply only when a service is outsourced
They apply only to new services and not to existing services
They are a replacement for practices
They are relevant to every service and to the service value system

explanations.a: Supplier clue 114: regarding four dimensions of service management, supplier decisions are one dimension, but the full model applies more broadly.
explanations.b: Workflow clue 114: regarding four dimensions of service management, existing services also need holistic review and improvement.
explanations.c: Recall check 114: regarding four dimensions of service management, the dimensions provide perspectives; practices still provide organizational resources for work.
explanations.d: The four dimensions should be considered for services and across the service value system. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which statement about organizations and people is CORRECT?

answers.text: Culture and communication can affect how effectively services are managed
This dimension is considered only after a tool has been purchased
This dimension is relevant only to HR services
This dimension excludes skills because skills are part of technology

explanations.a: People, culture, communication, and structures influence service management outcomes. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Definition clue 119: regarding organizations and people, people considerations should be included throughout service design and improvement.
explanations.c: Scenario clue 119: regarding organizations and people, organizations and people affects all service management, not just HR-related services.
explanations.d: Answer boundary 119: regarding organizations and people, skills and competencies are part of the organizations and people dimension.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: A federal agency's service desk is reviewing how it handles user requests. Which factor is part of the organizations and people dimension?

answers.text: Data formats, databases, and integration platforms
Roles, responsibilities, culture, staffing, skills, and organizational structure
Contracts, sourcing models, and supplier relationships
Workflow steps and process inputs and outputs

explanations.a: Practice logic 120: regarding organizations and people, those belong mainly to the information and technology dimension.
explanations.b: The organizations and people dimension includes human, structural, cultural, and capability aspects. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Recognition clue 120: regarding organizations and people, those belong mainly to the partners and suppliers dimension.
explanations.d: Foundation check 120: regarding organizations and people, those belong mainly to the value streams and processes dimension.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: A new service fails because support teams were not trained and responsibilities were unclear. Which dimension was most affected?

answers.text: Partners and suppliers
Value streams and processes
Organizations and people
Information and technology

explanations.a: Concept contrast 121: regarding organizations and people, supplier management is not the main issue when internal teams lack training and responsibilities.
explanations.b: Exam wording 121: regarding organizations and people, process design may help, but the specific weakness is people readiness and role definition.
explanations.c: Skills, roles, responsibilities, and training are part of organizations and people. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Role clue 121: regarding organizations and people, technology may be involved, but the problem describes people capability and role clarity.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which statement about information and technology is CORRECT?

answers.text: Which process steps should happen first?
Which teams need new job titles?
Which external supplier contract should be renewed?
What information is needed, and what technology will support the service?

explanations.a: Supplier clue 122: regarding information and technology, process sequencing fits value streams and processes.
explanations.b: Workflow clue 122: regarding information and technology, job titles and team design fit organizations and people.
explanations.c: Recall check 122: regarding information and technology, supplier contracts fit partners and suppliers.
explanations.d: This dimension considers the information and technology needed to enable service management. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which factor is part of the information and technology dimension?

answers.text: Information, knowledge, applications, infrastructure, communication systems, and technology architecture
Organizational culture and team motivation
Supplier selection criteria and contract terms
Activity sequencing across a value stream

explanations.a: This dimension covers information and the technologies that support service management. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Definition clue 123: regarding information and technology, culture and motivation belong mainly to organizations and people.
explanations.c: Scenario clue 123: regarding information and technology, supplier decisions belong mainly to partners and suppliers.
explanations.d: Answer boundary 123: regarding information and technology, activity sequencing belongs mainly to value streams and processes.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: A service depends on accurate data, secure integrations, and appropriate collaboration tools. Which dimension is most relevant?

answers.text: Partners and suppliers
Information and technology
Value streams and processes
Organizations and people

explanations.a: Practice logic 124: regarding information and technology, suppliers may provide tools, but the focus is on data, integrations, and technology.
explanations.b: Data, integrations, and tools are key concerns in the information and technology dimension. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Recognition clue 124: regarding information and technology, processes may use information, but the question centers on information and technology choices.
explanations.d: Foundation check 124: regarding information and technology, people may use the tools, but the described concerns are information and technology issues.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which statement about partners and suppliers is CORRECT?

answers.text: Supplier relationships remove the need to define internal responsibilities
Suppliers are outside the service value system and do not affect service value
The organization should consider how supplier relationships affect value, risk, cost, and service outcomes
Supplier management is needed only when the service is fully outsourced

explanations.a: Concept contrast 125: regarding partners and suppliers, supplier use still requires internal ownership and coordination.
explanations.b: Exam wording 125: regarding partners and suppliers, suppliers can strongly influence service outcomes and value creation.
explanations.c: Supplier relationships influence service value, risk, cost, and outcomes. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Role clue 125: regarding partners and suppliers, even partly outsourced services can depend on suppliers and partners.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which factor is part of the partners and suppliers dimension?

answers.text: Internal culture and role descriptions
Databases and technical integrations
Step-by-step process activities
Relationships with other organizations involved in service design, delivery, support, and improvement

explanations.a: Supplier clue 126: regarding partners and suppliers, those belong mainly to organizations and people.
explanations.b: Workflow clue 126: regarding partners and suppliers, those belong mainly to information and technology.
explanations.c: Recall check 126: regarding partners and suppliers, those belong mainly to value streams and processes.
explanations.d: The partners and suppliers dimension covers external relationships that contribute to services. This is the correct answer.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: A children's hospital's IT department is updating its operations playbooks. A service relies on a cloud provider, a network carrier, and a support vendor. Which dimension should receive particular attention?

answers.text: Partners and suppliers
Information and technology
Value streams and processes
Organizations and people

explanations.a: External providers and their relationships are central to the partners and suppliers dimension. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Definition clue 127: regarding partners and suppliers, technology is involved, but the focus is reliance on suppliers.
explanations.c: Scenario clue 127: regarding partners and suppliers, processes coordinate the work, but the key concern is supplier dependency.
explanations.d: Answer boundary 127: regarding partners and suppliers, internal people remain important, but the described dependency is on external organizations.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which statement about value streams and processes is CORRECT?

answers.text: They should be designed without considering outcomes
They describe how different activities combine to enable value creation
They are limited to the service desk team
They replace the need for information and technology

explanations.a: Practice logic 128: regarding value streams and processes, value streams should be designed around value and desired outcomes.
explanations.b: Value streams and processes show how work is organized and connected to create value. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: Recognition clue 128: regarding value streams and processes, value streams and processes can span many teams and practices.
explanations.d: Foundation check 128: regarding value streams and processes, processes and value streams often depend on information and technology.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: Which statement about value streams and processes is CORRECT?

answers.text: Employee motivation and organizational culture
External contracts and supplier sourcing strategy
The activities, workflows, controls, inputs, and outputs used to create products and services
Data storage platforms and communication tools

explanations.a: Concept contrast 129: regarding value streams and processes, those belong mainly to organizations and people.
explanations.b: Exam wording 129: regarding value streams and processes, those belong mainly to partners and suppliers.
explanations.c: This dimension considers how work flows through activities and processes to create value. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: Role clue 129: regarding value streams and processes, those belong mainly to information and technology.

questions.name: Understand the four dimensions of service management
questions.text: A team maps how a request moves from submission to fulfilment, including handoffs and outputs. Which dimension is being applied?

answers.text: Partners and suppliers
Organizations and people
Information and technology
Value streams and processes

explanations.a: Supplier clue 130: regarding value streams and processes, suppliers may participate in the workflow, but the focus is the value stream and process.
explanations.b: Workflow clue 130: regarding value streams and processes, people perform the work, but the main concern is the flow of activities and outputs.
explanations.c: Recall check 130: regarding value streams and processes, technology may support the workflow, but the described activity is work-flow mapping.
